The plain (-p) hexdump reader in python/mirage/commands/builtin/generic/xxd.py
(_plain_runs) and typescript/packages/core/src/commands/builtin/generic/xxd.ts
(plainRuns) follows xxd 2024-12-07 (src/xxd/xxd.c of vim 9.1.1230,
https://github.com/vim/vim). xxd.c carries this notice:

under X11-MIT or GPL-2.0 (at the user's choice).
